slots.heroHeading: Your Magical Girl Moment, Drawn by Hand
slots.description: ["Turn your favourite photo into a magical girl keepsake with a hand-drawn custom Sailor Moon portrait from Anime Cabinet. Our human artists create an original character inspired by the elegance, sparkle and 90s shoujo energy of Sailor Moon—not a copied copyrighted character or an AI filter. Expect expressive eyes, flowing hair, luminous colour, starry backgrounds and a confident transformation-sequence mood, while your real features, smile and personality remain recognisable.","Upload a clear photo, share your ideas and tell us which details matter most. You can request moon silver, rose pink or deep navy accents, ribbons, tiaras, wind-swept hair, a celestial background or a pose that feels completely yours. Couples can become guardian partners with complementary colour themes, while friend groups can be illustrated as a magical squad. Your artwork is drawn as an original fan-art-inspired portrait, so it captures the visual language without impersonating a specific anime character.","This custom anime portrait commission online starts at $39.99, and you’ll receive a preview within 72 hours. Unlimited free revisions are included, giving you time to refine colours, expressions, poses and small styling details before approval. The finished digital artwork works beautifully as a gift, wall print or custom anime portrait canvas. For more inspiration, explore our [Sailor Moon-inspired custom poster guide](/blog/sailor-moon-inspired-custom-poster), browse [gift ideas for Sailor Moon fans](/blog/best-gifts-for-sailor-moon-fans), or discover the wider [Anime Cabinet collection](/)."]
